provenance.page_map: 00-CONTENT-MAP.md, priority competitor alternatives and competitor-vs-competitor sections
provenance.adaptation: New researched pages implementing the existing map; source files are not overwritten. Detailed branded-alternative drafts for these six targets were not present in the accessible Library listing; no claim of verbatim preservation.

podium-larry.title: Podium — Larry for home services
podium-larry.note: Price-book access, service fees and dispatch-board booking are described; no blanket claim that Larry cannot quote.

podium-fsm.title: Podium — Field service management
podium-fsm.note: Describes HVAC, plumbing and electrical FSM; flat-rate services/parts; technician estimates; dispatch.

podium-plans.title: Podium — Plans and packages
podium-plans.note: Public home-services offer bundles Larry and FSM, with a sales-quote CTA; no numerical plan price shown.

sameday-product.title: Sameday AI — Product overview
sameday-product.note: Current site covers phones, AI CSRs, campaigns, coaching and connected scheduling. Not represented as message-taking only.

sameday-pricing.title: Sameday AI — Pricing
sameday-pricing.note: Launch starts at $449/month with 500 minutes; Scale at $789 with 1,000; Enterprise custom. Vendor-displayed dollars; confirm currency and contract. Old gosameday.com URL redirects here.

sameday-integrations.title: Sameday AI — Integrations
sameday-integrations.note: Names Jobber, ServiceTitan, FieldRoutes and Service Fusion; integration scope still needs an account-specific demonstration.

avoca-inbound.title: Avoca — Inbound AI CSR
avoca-inbound.note: Booking, customer recognition and human escalation with context. Current wording does not establish an outsourced human team in every plan.

avoca-coach.title: Avoca — Coach
avoca-coach.note: Call scoring, outcome reclassification and manager reporting.

avoca-product.title: Avoca — Product overview
avoca-product.note: Inbound, outbound, web chat and coaching. Reviewed offer is demo-led; no numerical subscription price found on reviewed product pages.

avoca-servicetitan.title: Avoca — ServiceTitan integration
avoca-servicetitan.note: Direct booking and customer/notes writeback while retaining ServiceTitan.

jobber-help.title: Jobber — Receptionist availability and usage
jobber-help.note: Select-plan add-on $29/month, 30 conversations, $0.79 additional conversation; Plus unlimited. Call and text counting differ.

jobber-pricing.title: Jobber — Plans and add-ons
jobber-pricing.note: Base Jobber subscription is separate from an add-on quote; Plus includes Receptionist. Prices vary by team/billing selection.

hcp-overview.title: Housecall Pro — CSR AI overview
hcp-overview.note: Booking and rescheduling permissions, call records and existing account context. Some overview prose still says coming soon; do not flatten this into an unavailable claim.

hcp-practices.title: Housecall Pro — CSR AI best practices and FAQs
hcp-practices.note: Set service prices, Online Booking, enabled services and available windows; no invented numerical subscription rate.

hcp-team.title: Housecall Pro — AI Team overview
hcp-team.note: CSR AI answering is an optional add-on, unlike included AI teammates. No numerical add-on price in reviewed material.

hcp-chat.title: Housecall Pro — CSR AI Chat Answering
hcp-chat.note: Website chat with settings, booking and human escalation; not described as lacking website communication.

hcp-text.title: Housecall Pro — CSR AI Text Answering (In Alpha)
hcp-text.note: Alpha, qualifying new-customer calls and permission-dependent actions. Not generalized to all customers or GA.

st-settings.title: ServiceTitan — Configure Voice Agent
st-settings.note: Job types, follow-up questions and configurable dispatch-fee messages.

st-pricing.title: ServiceTitan — AI Voice Agent public offer
st-pricing.note: Official indexed page lists $2.75/call, monthly usage billing and 12-month rate lock, no minimum calls. Direct parsed page body is JS-only; verify account eligibility/currency/base subscription separately. Not an all-in ServiceTitan price.
st-pricing.retrieval: Official search-indexed page; direct parsed body incomplete

st-escalation.title: ServiceTitan — Emergency escalation and after-hours dispatch fees
st-escalation.note: Applies to basic Phones, Phones Pro and Contact Center Pro; not an enterprise-contact-center-only feature.

st-multi.title: ServiceTitan — Multiple Voice Agents
st-multi.note: Independent agents for brands, service lines or locations within an account.

avoca-human.title: Avoca — Human in the Loop program
avoca-human.note: Avoca describes a team of Avoca-trained CSRs in North America. Program availability and price must be confirmed in the offer; not assumed included in every plan.

otc.name: Off The Clock AI / QuoteDone
otc.fact: Off The Clock combines an AI operator with QuoteDone: pricing supported jobs from your own rates and job details, with a website quote widget as a second customer entry point.
otc.pricing: QuoteDone: $279/month with 1,200 minutes in the project offer. Publication is pending.
otc.boundary: Not a replacement for a full field-service platform. Unresolved pricing or job facts require owner review; a live native connection to another vendor is not implied.

podium.name: Podium Larry
podium.short: An AI operator within a broader operating system
podium.fact: Larry uses price-book and dispatch context. Podium’s home-services offer also includes an FSM.
podium.pricing: Sales quote; no numerical price in the reviewed home-services plans.
podium.boundary: Establish whether you are buying Larry alone, integrated access, or the full advertised platform.

sameday.name: Sameday AI
sameday.short: Connected scheduling and a broader phone operation
sameday.fact: Sameday combines AI call handling with phones, scheduling, campaigns and coaching. Its integration directory includes Jobber and ServiceTitan.
sameday.pricing: Launch from $449/month, 500 minutes; Scale from $789, 1,000 minutes.
sameday.boundary: Confirm the exact integration actions, included features and extra-usage terms in your proposal.

avoca.name: Avoca
avoca.short: AI front office, coaching and escalation
avoca.fact: Avoca combines inbound handling, outbound campaigns and coaching; it also documents a trained-human backup program.
avoca.pricing: Sales-led; no numerical price found in the reviewed product material.
avoca.boundary: Ask who handles escalations and whether that human coverage and each module are included.

jobber.name: Jobber Receptionist
jobber.short: Native answering for an existing Jobber operation
jobber.fact: Receptionist answers calls and texts and can book into Jobber. Plus includes unlimited usage.
jobber.pricing: Select-plan add-on: $29/month for 30 conversations; $0.79 each beyond that. Base plan separate.
jobber.boundary: Compare the add-on with your existing Jobber bill, not with an entire standalone subscription.

hcp.name: Housecall Pro CSR AI
hcp.fact: CSR AI uses HCP service and scheduling settings. Its documentation covers booking permissions, service prices and website chat.
hcp.pricing: Optional add-on; numerical price not established by the reviewed official documentation.
hcp.boundary: Verify permissions, available services and booking windows in the actual account.

st.name: ServiceTitan Voice Agent
st.fact: Voice Agent supports configured job types, dispatch-fee messaging and escalation within ServiceTitan.
st.pricing: Official public offer: $2.75 per call; underlying ServiceTitan costs and eligibility are separate.
st.boundary: A usage rate is not the total software cost. Verify the account, phone setup and billable-call definition.
